name: @guardbee/mcp-unbounded-consumption-auditor
description: MCP server that scans LLM/agent application code for Unbounded Consumption ("denial of wallet") anti-patterns from OWASP LLM Top 10 2026's #6 category
long_description: Unbounded Consumption is OWASP's LLM Top 10 2026 #6 risk category: nothing stops an LLM/agent application from making unlimited billable calls. This package scans source code for five concrete shapes of that risk. Missing output limits: an OpenAI chat completion call with neither max_tokens nor max_completion_tokens set (Anthropic's SDK already makes max_tokens a required argument, so it isn't checked there). Missing timeouts: a hand-rolled requests/axios/fetch call to a known LLM endpoint with no timeout/AbortSignal -- the official SDKs already ship a bounded default, so only custom HTTP calls are flagged. Unbounded loops: a hand-rolled while(true)/while True: agent loop that dispatches tool calls with no iteration cap, or a retry loop that catches an exception and continues with no attempt counter. Disabled safety limits: LangChain's AgentExecutor max_iterations or openai-agents-python's Runner max_turns explicitly set to None, removing a framework's own built-in loop cap (both verified against real SDK source before being shipped). Missing rate limiting: an MCP tool handler that makes a billable downstream call with nothing suggesting per-caller throttling -- no MCP SDK provides this out of the box, so it's a heuristic, medium-severity signal rather than a hard rule.
